verdict.rationale: Otter is a SaaS platform with a Public API, MCP server, and webhooks, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. The help-center review of the Public API states there is no sandbox. Nothing in the pack documents a test workspace, mock data, or any way to exercise integrations without touching live meeting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
